about.text: Figure 5: the Duplex model coloured by operational carbon (kgCO2e/yr) from nrc_analytics_elements.csv, joined on GlobalId, on the viridis scale from 14.2 (dark purple) to 412 (yellow). 21 of the 714 mesh instances stay grey: their elements have no row in the CSV. Figures 6 and 7 are this graph with answer's valueColumn set to EmbodiedCarbon_A1A3_kgCO2e (viridis) or Category (category10).
